questions.stem:
Practice form 3.
Which survey design is most clearly biased?
A) Ask only gym members whether the city should build more gyms.
B) Randomly sample city residents.
C) Use a complete resident list for selection.
D) Allow selected residents to answer anonymously.

options.A: Ask only gym members whether the city should build more gyms.
options.B: Randomly sample city residents.
options.C: Use a complete resident list for selection.
options.D: Allow selected residents to answer anonymously.

questions.explanation: Sampling only gym members overrepresents a group with a strong interest.
